title: dns.resolve truncates names containing NUL char
vulnerabilityInformation: A patch for CVE-2026-48930 was found to be incomplete. The fix rejected embedded NUL bytes in DNS lookup entry points but failed to apply the same validation to dns.resolve* entry points that interface with c-ares binding. When a NUL character was passed within a hostname to dns.resolve4(), the call did not throw an error and instead truncated the name at the NUL byte before querying the DNS server. This allowed a different hostname to be resolved than the one validated by the application, bypassing hostname validation checks in SSRF allowlists and DNS-rebinding guards. The vulnerability affected all dns.resolve* methods in both callback and promise APIs.
